content.text: What have you heard about where spring training is going to be at? Off the record
A couple of the TV reporters up here said Lakeland. That’s what I’ve heard all along. But I’m getting some conflicting reports today
I think they’re gonna have to train in Detroit because it’s bad optics to do it down there
I think they’d much rather do it down there but before I bring this up to my source, tell me I don’t sound like a dumbass

You think big picture with it. You don’t have one field just at Comerica Park. You have the Wayne State field and you can run workouts at the Detroit youth field where Tiger Stadium used to be and find some high school fields in DETROIT
Like, infielders go here one day. People would come watch you guys, no doubt. But then it’s the issue of the virus and you can’t control that
So I don’t think there’s any way of that happening so I’m not gonna bring it up lol
